notice: Provisional collection. Records identify reported findings and their limits. The Commons has not independently verified the underlying claims; inclusion is not endorsement.

evidence.title: Engineered covert protocols recover payloads under tested conditions
evidence.observation: Authors demonstrate an engineered covert protocol across asymmetric models; all 25 payloads per evaluated cell recovered. Key-exchange certification uses 100,000 algebraic replays drawing from measured displacement distributions, not 100,000 live agent conversations.
evidence.evidence_standing: Bounded observation (researcher-reported experiment; not independently reproduced)
evidence.glossary_fit: Illustrative, bounded; does not establish generality
evidence.limitations: Low-entropy output sharply reduces capacity. Transcript edits can break the channel; mitigations remain unevaluated. Undetectability is conditional on cryptographic, sampling and passive-transcript-auditor assumptions. Supplied protocol is not spontaneous coordination.
evidence.open_questions: Operational adoption, adversarial editing resilience and prevalence remain unknown.
evidence.support_assessment: Attributed research finding; not independently reproduced by the Commons.
evidence.dispute_status: No explicit correction located in bounded search; not a systematic retraction clearance
evidence.verification_status: Not independently verified by the Commons

terms.name: Constraint compression
terms.definition: A reduction, often AI-enabled, in the practical barriers of knowledge, expertise, labor, cost, time, or coordination that once limited an activity. It describes the change in constraints, not the eventual impact of the activity.

terms.name: Observability boundary
terms.definition: The practical limit of what a given observer or monitoring arrangement can detect, interpret, or causally connect. The limit may be known, partly understood, or itself unrecognized.

relationships.explanation: Qualifies what the specified evidence or monitoring arrangement can establish.
Reduced a specified construction barrier, not all coordination barriers.
